title: Briefing for 2026-10-07
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-07: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Trade deficit hits $105.6 billion, widest since just before Trump tariffs enacted last year. World Bank warns of AI concentration risks as it lifts East Asia and Pacific growth outlook to 4.5%. The 2029 tipping point: Western populations are about to start shrinking, piling pressure on public finances. Men are losing ground in the labor market. Here's why. Labor market faltered in September as jobs increased by just 29,000, unemployment rate rose to 4.2%. The September jobs report will be released Friday. Here's what to expect.
global: US death row inmate Christa Pike awake and speaking after failed execution, lawyers say. Ship sinks and crew missing after Black Sea drone attack. UK risks being 'uninvestable' if new oil and gas fields not approved, warns Equinor. Asos confirms hackers sent 'unauthorised' notification to app users. What can I do to protect myself after 'Asos hacked' message?. Paramount takes over Warner Bros in $110bn Hollywood merger.
philippines: Want to buy GCash shares? How retail investors can join the IPO. Health groups to lawmakers: Increase PhilHealth budget, not MAIFIP funding. Sara Duterte denies Gracioso’s claims | The wRap. Jeffrey Archer, UK novelist and scandal-plagued politician, dies on eve of final book.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
